testCase.name: [dev] S13 No email, mailto: or share path on any handoff screen, in either context

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S13 「两个模式下，任何交接页面上都没有邮件、mailto: 或分享路径」 No email, mailto: or share path on any handoff screen, in either context

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 No email client opens, no mailto: link fires, and there is no email or external-share path for a handoff under any condition, failures included (the After-Pilot no-PHI email notification is absent to …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U5 The handoff is generated and delivered entirely in-app, only to a signed-in, valid Round Companion recipient (another physician's account), never to an arbitrary email address; …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6；TFA-92586 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given make-session fixture as it is today (one patient per context)

When Open the Hospital sheet and its Send dialog (Cancel), the Handoffs inbox (Received and Sent), then the Nursing Home sheet and its Send dialog (Cancel)

Then Each screen is reached, and none has a mailto: link, an Email or Share control, an address field or an account email; destinations are names of app accounts only

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: every checkpoint has a positive anchor from the screen it is meant to show (so a snapshot of the wrong screen fails) and must not contain 'mailto:', 'Email', 'Share', '@roundai.test'. Playwright MCP snapshots print link targets (/url:), so a mailto: href is visible to the check. Detail screens are covered in S03a/S03b, the failure state in S18 and S20

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
